provenance.author: Codex
provenance.scope: Finalized class catalogue prepared at the owner's request. Role definitions are complete; tier mapping, numerical balance and implementation remain separate work.

premise.tribes: The 24 tribes provide their terrain adaptations, practical knowledge, fighting traditions and material constraints.
premise.pals: Trusted inner-circle people who survive the opening defeat with the protagonist and serve as upgraders.
premise.technology: Pals adapt future technology to tribal capabilities. Technology kits below establish each class's combat identity; exact equipment and upgrades vary within that identity.
premise.classes: A class is a combat job, independent of a particular tribe or named Pal.
premise.foundation_scope: Foundation descriptions identify skills a tribe could contribute. They do not establish any tribe's ancestry, canon profession list, inherent primitiveness or recruitment prerequisites.
premise.pal_scope: Pal identities, number, location and combat participation remain undecided. Field Engineer is a battlefield deployment role, not a replacement for Pals as upgraders.

rules: Exactly 17 distinct classes; Sovereign remains the Tier 7 identity and is not an eighteenth class.
Tribes field selected classes; the catalogue does not require every tribe/class combination.
Shared class logic and authored tribe/equipment data express variation. Distinct body plans and equipment still need compatibility and animation review.
Items and upgrades develop each class's core role. They do not create extra top-level classes by default.
Progression-based class unlocks are required; exact requirements and tier links are not assigned here.
Earlier-unlocked roles should remain useful as new roles unlock; class unlock order alone does not imply a replacement hierarchy.

classes.name: Warden
classes.role: Protect an ally and hold ground.

signature.name: Guard
signature.description: Project short-lived protection onto a nearby ally while remaining within guarding distance.

classes.weakness: Poor pursuit; guarding commits the Warden to the ally.

classes.name: Vanguard
classes.role: Open an engagement and create room for allies.
classes.technology_kit: Powered impact harness and shock weapon.

signature.name: Breakthrough
signature.description: Charge a short path and stagger the first eligible enemy hit.

classes.weakness: A committed charge can leave the Vanguard isolated.

classes.name: Duelist
classes.role: Defeat a single opponent through timing.
classes.technology_kit: Powered blade and reactive guard bracer.

signature.name: Riposte
signature.description: Briefly guard against one eligible strike and deliver a counterattack.

classes.weakness: Multiple attackers overwhelm the single-strike defence.

classes.name: Berserker
classes.tribal_foundation: Shock fighter accustomed to physical risk.
classes.technology_kit: Combat stim regulator and powered melee weapon.

signature.name: Bloodrush
signature.description: Increase melee damage for a short period while reducing personal defence.

classes.weakness: The damage advantage makes sustained punishment more dangerous.

classes.name: Marksman
classes.role: Remove a dangerous single target at distance.
classes.technology_kit: Smart optics and a precision ranged weapon.

signature.name: Aimed Shot
signature.description: Aim briefly before firing a powerful shot into a chosen target.

classes.weakness: Close pressure and interruption deny the aiming window.

classes.name: Skirmisher
classes.technology_kit: Light ranged weapon and a mobility harness.

signature.name: Running Shot
signature.description: Combine a light shot with a short reposition along a valid route.

classes.weakness: Lower burst damage; needs space to escape.

classes.name: Artillerist
classes.role: Punish clustered enemies and defended positions.
classes.technology_kit: Portable explosive launcher and targeting display.

signature.name: Bombard
signature.description: Launch a delayed explosive into a marked ground area.

classes.weakness: A slow firing cycle lets mobile enemies escape the impact.

classes.name: Infiltrator
classes.role: Reach a priority target through a flank.
classes.technology_kit: Signature-masking equipment and a compact powered blade.

signature.name: Ambush
signature.description: Use the equipment to approach a flank and deliver an opening burst against a priority target.

classes.weakness: Fragile when exposed in a sustained frontal fight.

classes.name: Trapper
classes.tribal_foundation: Hunter familiar with routes and ambush sites.

signature.name: Snare
signature.description: Place a trap that arms, triggers on an eligible enemy and briefly restrains it.

classes.weakness: Requires anticipation; unused placements contribute nothing.

classes.name: Recon
classes.role: Expose the defences of a dangerous enemy for the squad.

signature.name: Expose
signature.description: Complete a short scan, reveal relevant target information and apply a temporary vulnerability mark.

classes.weakness: Time spent scanning is inefficient against short-lived enemies.

classes.name: Medic
classes.role: Restore an ally's health during a fight.
classes.tribal_foundation: Healer with practical knowledge of their people's bodies.
classes.technology_kit: Compatible medical applicator and regenerative treatment kit.

signature.name: Field Treatment
signature.description: Deliver a short targeted treatment that restores health.

classes.weakness: Vulnerable while treating; cannot answer every wound at once.

classes.name: Herald
classes.tribal_foundation: War caller or trusted rallying figure.

signature.name: Rally
signature.description: Send a short-range stabilising pulse that restores nearby allies' sanity.

classes.weakness: Low personal damage; loses reach when allies split apart.

classes.name: Chemist
classes.role: Weaken enemies occupying a small area.
classes.tribal_foundation: Compound maker with knowledge of local reagents.

signature.name: Suppressant
signature.description: Throw a limited-charge canister that briefly reduces affected enemies' damage within its cloud.

classes.weakness: Finite charges; enemies can move out of the affected area.

classes.name: Field Engineer
classes.role: Establish sustained pressure at a selected position.

signature.name: Sentry
signature.description: Deploy one temporary stationary sentry that attacks eligible nearby enemies.

classes.weakness: The sentry is destructible and loses value when the fight moves away.

classes.name: Disruptor
classes.role: Interrupt an enemy's dangerous action or disable compatible protection.
classes.tribal_foundation: Saboteur or fighter skilled at timing an interruption.

signature.name: Disruption Pulse
signature.description: Interrupt an interruptible active ability and briefly suppress a compatible technology shield.

classes.weakness: Limited direct damage; a target with no eligible action or shield provides little value.

classes.name: Binder
classes.role: Pull an enemy out of its intended position.

signature.name: Tether
signature.description: Attach a visible tether and pull one displacement-eligible enemy toward the Binder within valid terrain.

classes.weakness: Limited range; anchored targets resist the pull.

classes.name: Conduit
classes.role: Deliver sustained relic-powered damage at personal mental risk.
classes.tribal_foundation: Fighter trained to endure a dangerous relic interface.
classes.technology_kit: Recovered relic emitter with a neural interface.

signature.name: Channel
signature.description: Sustain an offensive relic beam while consuming personal sanity; releasing the channel ends the drain.

classes.weakness: Exposed while channeling; repeated use approaches a mental break.

class_boundaries.distinction: Warden sustains protection near an ally; Vanguard commits movement to start an engagement.
Duelist times counters; Berserker trades defence for pressure; Infiltrator uses a flank for opening burst.
Marksman aims at one target; Skirmisher attacks and repositions; Artillerist threatens a delayed ground area.
Trapper anticipates a future route; Binder immediately changes one eligible enemy's position.
Recon exposes information and vulnerability; Disruptor stops eligible actions or suppresses compatible shields.
Medic restores health; Herald restores sanity; Chemist weakens enemies with delivered compounds.
Field Engineer deploys a separate stationary attacker; Conduit personally sustains an attack while spending sanity.

shared_rule_baseline: Targets must be alive and eligible when an action resolves; invalid targets receive no effect.
Moves, charges and pulls must remain on valid battlefield terrain. They stop at blocking geometry.
Damage mitigation, status duration and stacking caps must be specified before implementation; the same effect must use one shared resolution rule.
Interrupt, parry, restraint, displacement and shield suppression use explicit eligibility flags. Bosses and cosmic threats are not automatically controllable or hackable.
A resisted control action must give readable feedback; immunity must not depend on a hidden random exception.
Medical treatment must respect the fighter's compatibility data. The class is not a universal cure for every body or a resurrection mechanic.
Conduit uses the existing sanity concept rather than introducing a separate class resource. Exact drain, break interaction and cancellation timing require balancing.
Allies and enemies must be visually distinguishable around shields, clouds, traps, tethers and beams at the intended 2.5D battle scale.

scope_changes.reason: Ground the flanking role in signature-masking equipment and a compact weapon.
Make scanning and target designation immediately legible as a combat role.
Medical technology provides health recovery; the draft's sanity-cost healing is removed.
Local reagent knowledge combined with synthesis and delivery technology.
Distinguish battlefield deployment from the Pals' upgrade function.
Replace the erroneous creature-Pal assumption with counter-ability and compatible shield suppression.
Active relic channeling with sanity risk; passive Mercy generation is not this class's defining role.
